questions.stem_text: Which of the following is a consequence of a protective tariff on imported steel?

options.B: Income is transferred from domestic steel consumers to domestic steel producers.
options.D: Income is transferred from domestic steel to foreign steel producers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Income is transferred from domestic steel consumers to domestic steel producers.

questions.stem_text:
Corn is exchanged in a competitive market. Which of the following definitely increases the
equilibrium price of corn?

options.A: Both supply and demand shift rightward.
options.B: Both supply and demand shift leftward.
options.C: Supply shifts to the right; demand shifts to the left.
options.D: Supply shifts to the left; demand shifts to the right.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Supply shifts to the left; demand shifts to the right.

questions.stem_text: If prices rise in the United States relative to other countries then

options.A: the value of the dollar will tend to appreciate.
options.B: the value of the dollar will tend to depreciate.
options.C: exchange rates will be affected but not the value of the dollar.
options.D: the exchange rate will not be affected.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the value of the dollar will tend to depreciate.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements is accurate in regard to a perfectly competitive firm?

options.B: The demand curve lies above the marginal revenue curve.
options.C: Price is determined by the equilibrium in the entire market.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Price is determined by the equilibrium in the entire market.

questions.stem_text:
If corn is produced in a perfectly competitive market and the government placed a price
ceiling above equilibrium, which of the following would be true?

options.A: There would be no change in the amount of corn demanded or supplied.
options.B: There would be a shortage created of corn.
options.C: There would be a surplus created of corn.
options.D: The producers of corn would lose revenue due to the decreased price.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - There would be no change in the amount of corn demanded or supplied.
